api:
<Spider data={players} axes={axes} name={|p: &Player| p.name} value={|p: &Player, axis: usize| p.stats[axis]} max={100.} />
PropTypeDefault
dataas above: one row per shaperequired
axesVec<SharedString>: one spoke each, clockwise from the toprequired
nameFn(&T) -> &strrequired
valueFn(&T, usize) -> f64: the row's value on spoke axisrequired
maxf64: the value at the rimthe largest value
levelsusize: grid rings5
gridSpiderGrid::Polygon or SpiderGrid::CirclePolygon
fill_opacityf320.2
line_widthf32, pixels2.
legendLegend: click an entry to hide or isolate a shapea list
tooltipTooltip: every shape's value on the hovered spokeshown
classTailwind classes ("h-64")

All spokes share one scale from 0 to max. Values above it reach past the rim.

examples.title: Three players
examples.description: Six skills per player on a 0–100 web; hover a spoke to compare.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn compare() {
    let data = use_signal(players());
    rsx! { <Spider data={data} axes={axes()} name={|p: &Player| p.name} value={|p: &Player, axis: usize| p.stats[axis]} max={100.} class="h-96" /> }
}

examples.title: Circular grid
examples.description: One player on a circular grid.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn circles() {
    let data = use_signal(players().into_iter().take(1).collect::<Vec<_>>());
    rsx! { <Spider data={data} axes={axes()} name={|p: &Player| p.name} value={|p: &Player, axis: usize| p.stats[axis]} max={100.} grid={SpiderGrid::Circle} fill_opacity={0.35} class="h-96" /> }
}

examples.title: Legend on the right

}

examples.title: Phone review
examples.description: Four phones rated 0–10 on five qualities.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn phone_review() {
    let data = use_signal(phones());
    rsx! { <Spider data={data} axes={labels(&["Camera", "Battery", "Display", "Speed", "Value"])} name={|r: &Rated| r.name} value={|r: &Rated, axis: usize| r.scores[axis]} max={10.} class="h-96" /> }
}
